description:
Open-source multi-track video and audio editor
Videomator is a free and open-source multi-track video and audio editor for Android, in the style of Vegas Pro / CapCut.

Features:
- Multi-track timeline (video tracks with picture-in-picture overlays + audio tracks)
- Non-destructive editing: trim with finger handles, split, merge (real render), duplicate, ripple delete
- Real-time playback of the whole mix on a single clock (AudioTrack), with live edits during playback
- Clip effects: volume, pitch (semitones, duration preserved), speed, fade in/out, presets
- Video: rotate, flip, crop, brightness/contrast/saturation, overlay position/size/opacity
- Microphone recording directly into the timeline
- Timeline markers, A-B loop, metronome, snap to grid/clip edges/playhead
- Undo/redo, multi-select with contextual toolbar, range selection on the ruler
- Export: MP4 (H.264 + AAC) via the platform MediaCodec pipeline, or WAV / M4A audio mixdown
- Projects saved as portable JSON, with autosave

No accounts, no network, no proprietary code: video and audio are processed entirely with the platform codecs (MediaExtractor / MediaCodec / MediaMuxer / AudioTrack / AudioRecord). All dependencies are free software (AndroidX, Kotlin coroutines, Gson).

License: AGPL-3.0-only.
